name: sonner
title: Toast
description: Brief, non-blocking notifications — a token-styled Sonner toaster with success/error/warning/info variants that follows the theme.

meta.whenNotToUse: Errors the user must resolve, destructive confirmations, or essential info — use inline or a Dialog.
